say:1:1034139001:0.text: Many of the hornleaf bears suddenly left. We're safe for now.
say:1:1034139001:0.source_cn: 刚才大部分叶角熊突然离开了，暂时安全。
say:1:1034139001:0.male: Many of the hornleaf bears suddenly left. We're safe for now.
say:1:1034139001:0.female: Many of the hornleaf bears suddenly left. We're safe for now.

say:2:1034139002:0.text: But I'm not sure if all have gone. Be careful when you head that way.
say:2:1034139002:0.source_cn: 但我不确定它们是不是全都走了，你往那边去的时候，千万要小心。
say:2:1034139002:0.male: But I'm not sure if all have gone. Be careful when you head that way.
say:2:1034139002:0.female: But I'm not sure if all have gone. Be careful when you head that way.

say:3:1034139003:0.text: If you see any sign of them, hide. Don't act tough and try to take them on.
say:3:1034139003:0.source_cn: 你要是看见了它们的踪影，躲着点，别和那些大家伙硬碰硬。
say:3:1034139003:0.male: If you see any sign of them, hide. Don't act tough and try to take them on.
say:3:1034139003:0.female: If you see any sign of them, hide. Don't act tough and try to take them on.
